SLICE SUCCESS CRITERIA
• Minimum Success -– Still images are acquired for at least 15
different lifted flames with different combinations of fuel flow and air
velocity with a single fuel, or at least 10 different lifted flames each
of two fuels, or at least 5 different lifted flames each of 3 or more
fuels.
• High Success -– Still images are acquired of at least 30 different
lifted flames total from at least 3 different fuels. The still images are
acquired with a blackbody characterized camera for soot pyrometry
or liftoff limits are determined for at least one fuel.
• Complete Success -– Testing conducted with all 12 fuel bottles, with
identification of stability limits and smoke points (within the range of
the SPICE velocity limits). Still images are taken of lifted flames with
a blackbody characterized camera.

SLICE PRODUCT VERIFICATION TESTING
• D300s Still Camera
– Functional Test
– Soft Stow Vibration per 60054-TST-007 - Complete
– Radiated Emissions Test – RE02 – Complete
• The original plan was to use similarity of design from the original camera however the EME
panel on 5/13/10 informed the project that it will be required to perform a radiated emissions
test.
– Thermal Operating Test per 60054-TST-009 – Complete
• 4 cycles from 10 to 45 ˚C
– Materials Bake-out for 72 hours at 120 ˚F – Complete
• The SPICE off-gas testing using the similar D100 camera as well as all other SPICE hardware
has a total T value of 0.001152. Using this value for just the new BASS D300s camera will
provide sufficient margin as well as allow the payload to remain below the 0.5 limit.
– Black Body Calibration and Focus Setup using Replacement Top Window. – 6/17/10
• Burner Tubes
– Perform dimensioning calibration - Complete
• Replacement Top Window
– Soft Stow Vibration per 60054-TST-007 - Complete
– Anneal at 250˚F for 1 hour - Complete
– Materials Bake-out for 72 hours at 120 ˚F - Complete

SAR-1 Concerns & Issues
• As-Built inspections of flight hardware was scheduled after the originally scheduled
SAR-2 on 6/11/10.
– The as-built inspections have been completed. DD250 is in the process of being generated
with the planned turnover to GRC at 3 PM today, 6/18/10.
• Stowage Configuration Drawings to close safety verification showing proper stow of
the hardware will be finalized at the Bench Review scheduled for 7/8/10.
– The PD will obtain the drawings once the updates have been made and include them in a
memo to close the verification.
• The D300s Camera completed EMI testing with the final results provided to MSG and
the EME panel. Due to some small exceedances from the requirement the payload
generated an NCR. MSG is generating a TIA to submit to the EME panel for
approval. Approval is expected.
• Crew Procedures are in draft form and are not planned to be completed until after
SAR-2.
– Crew procedures will be reviewed to include required safety controls. Operations will not be
conducted until these safety verifications have been closed.

BASS SUCCESS CRITERIA
• Minimal Success: 20 total tests including: eight tests
with flat samples (four materials at two different flow
speeds); four tests with spherical PMMA samples
(four different flow speeds with nitrogen
extinguishment); four tests with candles (four
different flow speeds with nitrogen extinguishment);
and four tests of PMMA wake flames (four different
flow speeds with nitrogen extinguishment).
• Complete Success: 60 flames as indicated in test
matrix.
